Drafted by gate/tools/wave.py (F14-T11) and read by the curator before import (R13). -/

open Filter Real Nat
open Erdos1004

theorem Opn.erdos_1004 :
    ∀ c > (0 : ℝ), ∀ᶠ x in atTop, ∃ n ≤ x,
      IsDistinctTotientRun n ⌊(Real.log (x : ℝ)) ^ c⌋₊ := by
  sorry
